# Pre-implementation Checklist: Scenario Injectors, Hold Loop and Effect Table

**Purpose**: requirements-quality review ("unit tests for English") of spec, plan, research and tasks before implementation. Depth: standard. Audience: reviewer / PR (data owner). Focus: (1) gate decisions and traceability, (2) safety, isolation and scope of change, (3) test-first order and the base-case guarantee.
**Created**: 2026-11-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · analysis: [analysis.md](../analysis.md)

**Note**: generated by the `validate-plan` gate. Review Ownership: reviewer-owned; mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied. `[x]` does not mean implementation work is complete. Finding ids (H1, M3, ...) refer to `analysis.md`.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is there a functional requirement (not only a research decision) for an incident with unknown duration, stating that it is open-ended and active until closed? [Gap, Spec §FR-021, research R6, analysis M5]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the consequences of an open-ended incident on the `incident` object (`duration_s` and `until` null) and on the bus state (`broken_down` with no end) written down for the data owner's review? [Gap, research R6, tasks.md:179]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the outcome of a hold above 90 s defined once, as either "refused at order build and reported `not_executed`" or "rejected at load with no row", so spec scenario 5, research R4.2 and contract hold-loop.md agree? [Conflict, Spec §US2 AC5, research.md:222, :233, analysis H3]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the way a decision written before the run becomes visible at the first simulated step defined (initial poll before the first event, and its time bound)? [Gap, research.md:217, tasks.md:105, analysis M1]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the expected instruction outcome defined when the held bus is also silent (D1(a)) during its stop, so no arrival or departure is reported? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, research R5, analysis M8]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the world-consistency clause of FR-005 ("buses do not overlap or pass each other", capacity 40) stated as an invariant that a test can check? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005, analysis M7]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the list of files that Phase 4 may change defined, so the "Untouched check" has a reference for the demo script, `demo.json`, the seed edit, `.gitignore` and their tests? [Gap, tasks.md:20, :177, analysis M2]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the removal condition of `config.seed_recommendation` and the seed file (when the real recommendation door exists) recorded where the backend owner will read it? [Assumption, data-model E3, Spec §Open integration items]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is "headway at the target stop after the horizon elapsed" reconciled with the plan's reading (the held bus's headway in the first snapshot at or after the horizon)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-023, research.md:32-39, analysis M4]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the clamp of the observed EWT at 0 stated as a requirement with its reason, instead of only in research and tasks? [Gap, Spec §FR-024, research R7]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "headway improved" defined for the cases where either value is null, and is that definition the same in spec, research R7 and the effect-rule task? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, research R7, tasks.md:130]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "about 8 minutes" in the demo quantified with a tolerance that the live run can be judged against? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-010, tasks.md:178]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "within one refresh cycle (5 s)" in SC-006 anchored to a defined instant (first snapshot in which the condition holds)? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the C5 "gap behind the stopped bus" defined for runs where fewer than three buses are on the corridor, so the fixture shape is not expected where it cannot occur? [Clarity, research R1, R9, Spec §US1 AC4]
- [ ] CHK015 Is it stated that `gold.instruction_status` is a partial form of `instruction.schema.json` (no `inst_id`, no `text`) and how a consumer completes it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, data-model E7]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 Does the list of tests that pin `RULES_VERSION` in the plan and tasks match every pin in the existing suite (including the two M1/M2 baseline assertions)? [Conflict, plan.md:134, tasks.md:50, analysis H1]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the spec statement that a scripted incident always has a numeric duration agree with ADR-0003 gate decision 3 and the nullable `command_event` payload? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases, contracts/read/command_event.schema.json:91-95]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the plan's Gate 4 statement ("the explicit approval step is exercised by the demo") agree with an approval written by a script at a fixed simulated time? [Conflict, plan.md:118, tasks.md:169, analysis M6]
- [ ] CHK019 Do the plan's time statement ("sum to the 4–5 hour budget") and the research budget table (5 h 35 min, 5 h 05 min after cuts) say the same thing? [Conflict, plan.md:258, research R14]
- [ ] CHK020 Does the scope of the "no write to bronze" static guard (rules, pipeline, refresh) agree with the claim that the new simulator files are covered by it? [Conflict, tasks.md:98, test_no_bronze_writes.py:14, analysis M3]
- [ ] CHK021 Does the Red rule list every test task that cannot be seen failing (the golden hash and the static truth guard)? [Consistency, tasks.md:17, :47, quickstart.md:47]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK022 Can "counts and states equal a `corridor_now` computed independently from the same bronze" be judged objectively, with the independent computation named? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, tasks.md:49]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the pass condition for the compliance batch (N = 200, share reported not asserted) stated so a reviewer knows what evidence closes SC-008? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008, research R4.3]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the demo pass criterion explicit when the effect `result` is not `worked` (recorded as the rule yields it, not tuned)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-010, tasks.md:178]
- [ ] CHK025 Is "bronze row count keeps growing" quantified (observation window, minimum growth) for the live isolation check? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-011, tasks.md:113]
- [ ] CHK026 Is "well inside the 5 s refresh interval" for the cycle time quantified (a number or a ratio)? [Ambiguity, research R12, tasks.md:133]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Is the effect-window-spans-a-data-fault case (held bus Estimated or silent at the before or after snapshot) covered by a stated expected value and a task? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, research R7, tasks.md:130]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the expected state of a bus silenced for 120 s or less (never Estimated) covered by a stated check, not only by config acceptance? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, tasks.md:43]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the live race (approval inside one poll interval before the arrival) written as a requirement with its conservative outcome (`not_executed`) and the demo timing that avoids it? [Coverage, plan.md Risks 5, research R4.1]
- [ ] CHK030 Are recovery requirements defined for the poller after a database outage (resume from the last seen id, no decision lost or applied twice)? [Gap, research R4.1, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the behavior defined when the simulator restarts while decisions already exist in bronze (board rebuilt from id 0, old decisions against a new run)? [Gap, research R4.1]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the failure mode defined for an existing volume that lacks `007_scenarios.sql` (clear error versus silent missing objects)? [Gap, research R8, plan.md Risks 6]

## Non-Functional Requirements (safety, isolation, security)

- [ ] CHK033 Is it required that every stack-changing or destructive compose command in a live check names its dedicated project in the same command, so no step can reach the default stack? [Gap, tasks.md:19, :68, :72, :113, :144, analysis H4]
- [ ] CHK034 Is a refuse-to-run guard (project variable must equal the dedicated project) required for every live test, as in story 003? [Gap, tasks.md:97, test_ingestion_outage_live.py:43-44]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the content of the poller's failure log line defined (exception class only, no message that could contain the host or the DSN)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028, contracts/README.md:37-40]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the "read-only" guarantee of the poller defined as a session setting on the ingestion role, with the move to a SELECT-only role recorded as turn-2 evolution? [Assumption, research R4.1, docs/turns-ritmo.md §3.3]
- [ ] CHK037 Are exclusions of secrets and PII defined for the demo outputs (`samples.csv`, `gold_steps.txt`, `truth.log`), not only for the truth file? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, tasks.md:170]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK038 Is the assumption that the generated `Recommendation` model enforces the 0 to 90 s hold bound validated against the generated code? [Assumption, research.md:222, data-model E3, analysis H3]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the assumption that the pipeline can read and subtract `end_ts = 'infinity'` (psycopg and PostgreSQL 16) validated, or is the SQL-side handling required? [Assumption, research.md:318, :328, analysis H2]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the pending confirmation by the backend owner (join by `rec_id`, recommendation door, `inst_id` and `text`) tracked with an owner and a decision point? [Dependency, research gate decision 3, tasks.md:179]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Items tagged `[Conflict]`, `[Gap]` or `[Ambiguity]` with an `analysis.md` finding id are the high-risk ones: CHK003, CHK004, CHK016, CHK033, CHK038, CHK039 first
